_comment: PostgreSQL REQUIREMENT metadata. This file describes what the user must install; it is
NOT a download manifest and nothing acts on it automatically.
Rising Path Recruiters never downloads, bundles, verifies or installs PostgreSQL.
scripts/build_installer.ps1 reads exactly one value from this file --
'required_postgres_major' -- and passes it to Inno Setup so the setup program can refuse
to install anything until a server of that major version is running on port 5432.
The setup payload contains no PostgreSQL installer, and the build fails if one appears.
The 'postgresql' block below is REFERENCE INFORMATION used for guidance: the official
build this deployment model was developed and tested against, and the URL the
documentation points people at. 'sha256', 'size_bytes' and 'authenticode_subject' are
the historical record of a pinning step that no longer runs -- keep them or drop them,
but do not read them as a promise that anything is verified at build time.
To require a newer PostgreSQL: change 'required_postgres_major'. To change what the

postgresql.authenticode_subject: CN=EnterpriseDB Corporation, O=EnterpriseDB Corporation, S=Massachusetts, C=US
postgresql.publisher: EDB (the official PostgreSQL Windows installer linked from postgresql.org)
notes: PostgreSQL 16 is a supported major version (community support to November 2028) and
matches the major version this project has been developed and tested against.
The user installs it themselves, interactively, keeping the default port 5432 and
choosing the postgres superuser credential that Rising Path Recruiters asks for once.
Nothing in this project runs that installer or passes it any options.

Newer majors pass, so nobody is sent to uninstall a working database server.
